lines.text: Dan drove into Zion at ten in the morning.
The visitor center lot was full, and the canyon road was closed to cars.
While the shuttle runs, hikers ride it to the trailheads.
Arrive before eight, park, and catch an early shuttle.
If the lot is full, park in Springdale and ride the free town shuttle when it's running.
Check nps.gov for this season's schedule.
Next morning, Dan's trail was quiet.
Save this before your Zion trip.
